additional_info.subject: VLAN Configuration in SCB
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
We have encountered issues when configuring the Open Port through VLAN on the WAN Port to the PLC in the SCB router settings. When loading the configuration, a "Network" error appears.
The example device corresponds to SCB ID hiQWJH.
We need to configure the ELMS, as we are setting up a DLMS system with a Sicam A8000 and using the client's network segment 192.168.1.xxx, according to the attached architecture.
With best regards,
Lodhar Aedo Lobos.
System Engineer.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0424499-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP / R6 170002002]VLAN Configuration CRM:02681000170
additional_info.body:
Hi Lodhar Maxwel Aedo Lobos,
I hope you are doing well.
As I checked, and as per the attached architecture document, it appears that all four units are connected to the XF3 router via wired WAN. There is some uncertainty about whether this functionality is supported when chargers are connected using wired WAN.
For further clarification and detailed instructions, I have created child case 0424762 for our Expert Team. Either they or we will get in touch with you.
Thank you for your understanding.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
